item.title: Restrictions concerning sending e-mails [resolved]
item.description:
Emails are now being sent reliably again. The limit of 20 documents per hour and a maximum of 5 recipients remains in place for the time being. The delay in email delivery has also been resolved.
We apologise for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

item.title: Processing of banking transactions and contacts import delayed [resolved]
item.description: Bank transactions have been successfully processed and imported. Contact imports are also available again. You can now use bexio as usual. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Limitations: There is a delay in the recording of bills in the accounting (e.g., journal) [resolved]
item.description: Bills are being processed as usual again. However, we are still working on the final data migration and kindly ask for a little more patience.
